description: macOS-only IPC for the live web app (0.7.10): native fullscreen of this app's OWN main window. The protected video player uses it so fullscreen stays inside the same capture-protected NSWindow instead of WebKit element fullscreen, which moves the web view into a new, unprotected window. It reads/writes no data. Kept out of app-remote.json so Windows/Linux shells never expose a fullscreen toggle to the remote origin.
